i0: **Gradable** adjectives can be more or less: *cold, big, good*. Use ***very, a bit*** and ***extremely*** with them: *very cold*. **Extreme** adjectives already mean “very”: *freezing, huge, amazing*. Use ***absolutely*** or ***really*** with them: *absolutely freezing*.
i1: Using the right word before an adjective is one of the easiest ways to sound more natural.
ga-basic.s: Use ***very / extremely / a bit*** with **gradable** adjectives (*very big*). Use ***absolutely*** or ***really*** with **extreme** adjectives (*absolutely huge*). ***Really*** works with both.
ga-basic.b1: Avoid *very freezing* or *absolutely cold*. ***Really*** is fine with both: *really cold, really freezing*.
